verdict.rationale: Browserbase explicitly advertises a URL-to-HTML/JSON/markdown fetch capability for agents, which matches a single-call scrape returning raw HTML, and its broader session/browser control API (docs-1, docs-4) supports scraping generally. However, no concrete API endpoint, request/response example, or independent hands-on confirmation of raw HTML output is shown. Missing for 10: a documented single-call endpoint/example returning raw HTML, and independent/third-party verification of extraction fidelity.
